name: issue_comment_check
title: Check issue comment
description: Check the arguments for add_issue_comment or update_issue_comment against the pecot rules before writing: the bundled comment template the body follows, and with update, that the comment belongs to the Issue. Reads and writes nothing on GitHub; pass the results of the official reads in reads.

method.description: add before add_issue_comment, update before update_issue_comment

owner.description: Owner of the repository of the Issue or PR the comment is on

repo.description: Name of the repository of the Issue or PR the comment is on

issue_number.description: Number of the Issue or PR the comment is on; with update, the Issue the comment must belong to

comment_id.description: With update only: id of the comment to rewrite (the id in the result of add_issue_comment)

body.description: Comment body, as passed to the write tool

template.description: Template the body follows: pecot-template://comment/<name> for a bundled one (its rules are checked); a replaced template's path or URL is accepted without checking the body

template_text.description: Text of a replaced template; the body is not checked against it

reads.description: Results of the official GitHub MCP reads the check needs

comments.description: With update: the result of issue_read with method get_comments for the same Issue

issue.description: Issue the problem belongs to: a batch key or owner/repo/N (omitted when the check covers one target)

field.description: Name of the argument that breaks the rule (title, body, issue_fields.<name>, blocked_by.<i>, ...)

code.description: Kind of the problem (missing-section, extra-heading, cycle, ...)

message.description: What is wrong and how to fix it, with the expected value when there is one

candidates.description: Values that would be accepted (omitted when there is no fixed set)

problems.description: Rules the arguments break; when empty, the arguments can be passed to the write tool as they are

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
